description: Shell script for testing recursive 'git fetch' operations on submodules, including setup, various fetch scenarios, and validation of submodule updates.

methods.name: write_expected_sub
methods.description: Generates expected output for submodule fetch in expect.err.sub file.

methods.name: write_expected_sub2
methods.description: Generates expected output for second submodule fetch in expect.err.sub2 file.

methods.name: write_expected_deep
methods.description: Generates expected output for deep submodule fetch in expect.err.deep file.

methods.name: write_expected_super
methods.description: Generates expected output for superproject fetch in expect.err.super file.

methods.name: add_submodule_commits
methods.description: Creates commits in submodules and writes expected fetch output files.

methods.name: add_superproject_commits
methods.description: Updates superproject and submodules, creating new commits and expected output files.

methods.name: verify_fetch_result
methods.description: Verifies that the actual fetch output matches expected concatenated output.

methods.name: fetch_with_recursion_abort
methods.description: Performs fetch with recursion, aborting on infinite recursion detection.

methods.name: add_commit_push
methods.description: Adds files, commits, and pushes in specified directory.

methods.name: compare_refs_in_dir
methods.description: Compares refs in two directories, with optional failure condition.
